name: full_resolution_sparse_mechanism_v1
description: Fresh full-resolution sparse-FEA re-evaluation of a generated mechanism under its stored BVP. Normalized linear-elastic units only; this is not a manufacturing or flight-qualification gate.

density_transform.pre_mask_outside_policy: For an integral coarse-to-source mapping, material in a zero-coverage coarse cell fails; mixed boundary-cell source-void occupancy is recorded as a representation alias and exact-domain masked before all checks.
density_transform.coarse_volume_projection: Use fractional source-area coverage weights at the model grid so nearest expansion followed by exact-domain masking preserves the requested active-domain volume fraction.

limitations: no dimensional material, thickness, yield, fatigue, buckling, contact, friction, process, or physical-test qualification
